Modular Kitchen Specifications & Standards

Delivered with certified materials, in-house factory manufacturing, and strict architectural discipline.

01

100% BWP Marine-Grade Core

Boiling Waterproof IS:710 calibrated marine ply cores that resist moisture, steam, and heavy usage.

02

BLUM & Hettich Hardware

Premium soft-close tandem boxes, lift-up Aventos systems, and corner carousel organizers.

03

Quartz & Sintered Stone Countertops

Stain-proof, scratch-resistant, and heat-tolerant solid stone worktops with seamless sink under-mounting.

04

Full-Height Pantry Pull-outs

Smart vertical storage units holding 100+ pantry essentials with smooth one-pull accessibility.

05

Under-Cabinet Task Lighting

Concealed 3000K warm LED strips that eliminate shadow on prep counters and cooking hobs.

06

Appliance & Hob Integration

Seamless housing for built-in ovens, dishwashers, chimneys, microwaves, and double-door refrigerators.
